mapper.insert: INSERT INTO otps_user ( id, account, password, nickname, user_image, phone_number, email, type, status, audit_status, audit_remark, create_time, update_time, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{user.id}, #{user.account}, #{user.password}, #{user.nickname}, #{user.userImage}, #{user.phoneNumber}, #{user.email}, #{user.type}, #{user.status}, #{user.auditStatus}, #{user.auditRemark}, #{user.createTime}, #{user.updateTime}, #{user.isDeleted} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, account, password, nickname, user_image, phone_number, email, type, status, audit_status, audit_remark, create_time, update_time, is_deleted FROM otps_user WHERE account = #{account} AND is_deleted = 0
